messages.subject: question about reroot
parts:
I am able to reroot my tree using the method 'reroot' with an internal node selected by 'MRCA". However, I have difficulties in rerooting my tree with only one single branch but not a group of branches. The method reroot does not accept external nodes (i.e. tips/leaves) as its input.
If possible, may authors please demonstrate some cases of rerooting and rotating trees?

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: question about reroot
parts:
set.seed(123)
tr=rtree(30)
x=reroot(tr, MRCA(tr, c("t5", "t15")))
multiplot(ggtree(tr)+geom_tiplab(), ggtree(x)+geom_tiplab(), ncol=2)


for rotating, see the vignettes.
